title: Mobile App Performance Review
summary: iOS cold start time improved 40% after recent optimization. Android still has memory leak in image caching. Push notification delivery at 94%, targeting 99%.
decisions: iOS optimization approach approved for Android implementation
Memory leak fix must be deployed before next release
Push notification permission UX to be redesigned
Target: 99% delivery rate by end of Q1
transcription: [15:00] Carlos Mendez: Mobile performance review. iOS first. [15:02] Emma Liu: Cold start down to 1.2 seconds from 2.0. Main improvement was deferring SDK initialization. [15:06] Carlos Mendez: That's significant. Any regressions? [15:08] Emma Liu: None detected. Crash rate stable at 0.3%. [15:10] Carlos Mendez: Android status? [15:12] James O'Brien: Memory leak confirmed in image cache. Working on fix. Cold start still at 2.8 seconds. [15:16] Carlos Mendez: Timeline for the memory fix? [15:18] James O'Brien: PR up this week. It's in the image loading library we forked. [15:22] Carlos Mendez: Push notifications? [15:24] Emma Liu: 94% delivery. Main issue is iOS provisional auth. Users declining. [15:28] Carlos Mendez: Let's discuss permission strategy separately.

actions.text: Submit image cache memory leak fix

risks.description: Android memory leak may affect app store ratings
